SQL_INJECTION.name: SQL Injection
SQL_INJECTION.description: User input flows to SQL execution without parameterization

COMMAND_INJECTION.name: OS Command Injection
COMMAND_INJECTION.description: User input flows to system command execution

CODE_INJECTION.name: Code Injection
CODE_INJECTION.description: User input flows to code evaluation or dynamic execution

XSS.name: Cross-Site Scripting
XSS.description: User input rendered in HTML without escaping

PATH_TRAVERSAL.name: Path Traversal
PATH_TRAVERSAL.description: User input used in file path without validation

SSRF.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
SSRF.description: User-controlled URL used in server-side requests

BROKEN_ACCESS_CONTROL.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
BROKEN_ACCESS_CONTROL.description: User-controlled ID used to access objects without ownership verification

WEAK_CRYPTO.name: Weak Cryptography
WEAK_CRYPTO.description: Use of weak cryptographic algorithms (MD5, SHA1, DES, RC4)

DEBUG_MODE_ENABLED.name: Debug Mode in Production
DEBUG_MODE_ENABLED.description: Debug mode enabled exposing sensitive information

MASS_ASSIGNMENT.name: Mass Assignment
MASS_ASSIGNMENT.description: Unrestricted object property assignment from user input

NOSQL_INJECTION.name: NoSQL Injection
NOSQL_INJECTION.description: User input flows to NoSQL query

INSECURE_RANDOM.name: Insecure Random Number Generation
INSECURE_RANDOM.description: Use of predictable random number generator for security-sensitive values such as secrets, keys, nonces, CSRF tokens, or upload filenames

OTP_INSECURE_RANDOM.name: OTP or Lookup Secret Generated With Insecure Random
OTP_INSECURE_RANDOM.description: OTP, lookup secret, recovery code, or out-of-band verifier is generated using a predictable general-purpose random number generator instead of a CSPRNG.

JWT_WEAK_SECRET.name: JWT with Weak Secret
JWT_WEAK_SECRET.description: JWT signed with weak or hardcoded secret

JWT_NONE_ALGORITHM.name: JWT None Algorithm Vulnerability
JWT_NONE_ALGORITHM.description: JWT configured to accept 'none' algorithm allowing signature bypass

PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION.name: Prototype Pollution
PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION.description: User input can pollute object prototype

BUFFER_OVERFLOW.name: Buffer Overflow
BUFFER_OVERFLOW.note: No static_code ASVS control covers buffer overflow. Nearest control is V1.4.1 (memory-safe string/buffer/pointer handling), detection_strategy=manual_attestation, and its own description marks it not applicable to memory-safe target languages (Python/JS/TS). Do not map.

GRAPHQL_INJECTION.name: GraphQL Injection
GRAPHQL_INJECTION.description: User input flows to GraphQL query

LOG_INJECTION.name: Log Injection
LOG_INJECTION.description: User input flows to logging without sanitization

INSECURE_COOKIE.name: Insecure Cookie Configuration
INSECURE_COOKIE.description: Cookie set without the Secure flag, leaving it exposed to interception over unencrypted connections

CLEARTEXT_TRANSMISSION.name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Data
CLEARTEXT_TRANSMISSION.description: HTTP used instead of HTTPS for sensitive data

ZIPSLIP_VULNERABILITY.name: Zip Slip Vulnerability
ZIPSLIP_VULNERABILITY.description: Archive extraction without path containment validation, allowing zip slip path traversal

REGEX_DOS.name: Regular Expression Denial of Service
REGEX_DOS.description: User input used in regex with potential catastrophic backtracking

INFORMATION_EXPOSURE_ERROR.name: Information Exposure Through Error Messages
INFORMATION_EXPOSURE_ERROR.description: Detailed error messages exposed to user

CLICKJACKING_NO_HEADER.name: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
CLICKJACKING_NO_HEADER.note: Nearest controls are V3.4.6 and V3.4.3 (frame-ancestors/CSP header), both detection_strategy=config_inspection — verified by the config inspector module against a live/config-file response header, not by a source-code regex. Mapping here would be inert since asvs_service only reads rule.asvs_controls for static_code verdicts. Do not map.

INSUFFICIENT_ENTROPY.name: Insufficient Entropy in Random Values
INSUFFICIENT_ENTROPY.description: Weak random number generation for security purposes

RACE_CONDITION_FILE.name: Time-of-Check Time-of-Use (TOCTOU)
RACE_CONDITION_FILE.description: File checked then used without locking

VULNERABLE_COMPONENTS.name: Vulnerable or Outdated Components
VULNERABLE_COMPONENTS.description: Dependency versions that are unpinned or use risky version ranges in manifest files
VULNERABLE_COMPONENTS.note: Nearest control is V15.2.1 (components within documented remediation time frames), detection_strategy=dependency_scan — verdict is taken directly from the dependency scanner's SLA evaluation (app/services/dependency_scanner.py), not from this rule catalog. Mapping here would be inert. Do not map.

ADMIN_ROUTE_UNPROTECTED.name: Admin Route Without Explicit Guard
ADMIN_ROUTE_UNPROTECTED.description: Admin route defined without explicit auth guard in the same line

A06_NPM_RESOLVED_HTTP.name: NPM Resolved URL Over HTTP
A06_NPM_RESOLVED_HTTP.description: Dependency resolved over insecure HTTP in lockfiles
A06_NPM_RESOLVED_HTTP.note: Nearest control is V15.2.4 (components sourced from the expected repository / dependency-confusion protection), detection_strategy=config_inspection, not static_code. Do not map.

A06_NPM_REGISTRY_HTTP.name: NPM Registry Over HTTP
A06_NPM_REGISTRY_HTTP.note: Nearest control is V15.2.4 (components sourced from the expected repository / dependency-confusion protection), detection_strategy=config_inspection, not static_code. Do not map.

A06_PYTHON_VCS_DEP.name: Python VCS Dependency
A06_PYTHON_VCS_DEP.description: Python dependency pulled from VCS URL
A06_PYTHON_VCS_DEP.note: Nearest control is V15.2.4 (components sourced from the expected repository / dependency-confusion protection), detection_strategy=config_inspection, not static_code. Do not map.

A06_PIPFILE_VCS.name: Pipfile VCS Dependency
A06_PIPFILE_VCS.note: Nearest control is V15.2.4 (components sourced from the expected repository / dependency-confusion protection), detection_strategy=config_inspection, not static_code. Do not map.

REMOTE_SCRIPT_EXECUTION.name: Remote Script Execution
REMOTE_SCRIPT_EXECUTION.description: Remote script fetched and executed directly

UNTRUSTED_BINARY_EXEC.name: Untrusted Binary Execution
UNTRUSTED_BINARY_EXEC.description: Downloads a binary and executes it without verification
UNTRUSTED_BINARY_EXEC.note: No static_code ASVS control targets unsigned/unverified binary execution. Nearest coverage (V15.1.5 'dangerous functionality' documentation, V15.2.4 dependency sourcing) is manual_attestation/config_inspection respectively. Do not map.

LOGGING_DISABLED.name: Logging Disabled
LOGGING_DISABLED.note: Nearest control is V16.1.1 (documented logging inventory), detection_strategy=manual_attestation. Every static_code-strategy logging control (V16.2.5, V16.3.1, V16.3.2, V16.3.4, V16.4.3) is already claimed by a more specific rule (SENSITIVE_LOGGING, AUTH_OPERATION_LOGGED_MARKER, AUTHZ_DENIAL_LOGGED_MARKER, HTTP_ERROR_HANDLER_SILENT, LOG_TRANSPORT_PLAINTEXT/CENTRALIZED_LOG_SHIPPING_MARKER). Do not map.

EXCEPT_PASS_NO_LOG.name: Exceptions Suppressed Without Logging
EXCEPT_PASS_NO_LOG.description: Exceptions or errors are caught and silently swallowed (except: pass, empty catch block) instead of being logged

HTTP_ERROR_HANDLER_SILENT.name: HTTP Error Handler Without Logging
HTTP_ERROR_HANDLER_SILENT.description: Error handler returns response without logging

AWS_METADATA_ACCESS.name: AWS Metadata Endpoint Access
AWS_METADATA_ACCESS.description: Direct access to AWS metadata IP

GCP_METADATA_ACCESS.name: GCP Metadata Endpoint Access
GCP_METADATA_ACCESS.description: Direct access to GCP metadata host

AZURE_METADATA_ACCESS.name: Azure Metadata Endpoint Access
AZURE_METADATA_ACCESS.description: Direct access to Azure metadata endpoint

IMDS_TOKENLESS.name: IMDSv1 Tokenless Request
IMDS_TOKENLESS.description: IMDS request without required token header

UNSAFE_URL_PROTOCOL.name: Unsafe URL Protocol / Unencoded Dynamic URL
UNSAFE_URL_PROTOCOL.description: Untrusted data used to build a URL without context-aware encoding, or unsafe URL protocols (javascript:, data:) reachable in a redirect/link.

JS_JSON_INJECTION.name: JavaScript / JSON Injection
JS_JSON_INJECTION.description: Untrusted data embedded into dynamically-built JavaScript or JSON content without output encoding, risking script or JSON injection.

MISSING_HTML_SANITIZER.name: Untrusted Rich-Text HTML Without Sanitization
MISSING_HTML_SANITIZER.description: Rich-text/WYSIWYG HTML input is rendered (innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, mark_safe) without an accompanying HTML-sanitization library call visible in context.

XXE_UNSAFE_XML_PARSER.name: XML Parser Without XXE Hardening
XXE_UNSAFE_XML_PARSER.description: An XML parser (ElementTree, lxml, SAX, minidom) is used without disabling external entity resolution, or with external entities explicitly enabled, risking XML External Entity (XXE) attacks.

INPUT_VALIDATION_MISSING.name: Business Input Used Without Visible Validation
INPUT_VALIDATION_MISSING.description: Request input is consumed directly in business/security-relevant logic without a visible allow-list validation layer (schema/model validator) in the same file.

CLIENT_SIDE_ONLY_VALIDATION.name: Validation Implemented Only Client-Side
CLIENT_SIDE_ONLY_VALIDATION.description: Input validation appears to rely on client-side HTML5 constraints or JS checks without a corresponding server-side validation layer.

UNSAFE_DOM_RENDERING.name: Unsafe DOM Rendering (innerHTML vs textContent)
UNSAFE_DOM_RENDERING.description: Content intended to be displayed as text is rendered via innerHTML/document.write/outerHTML instead of safe rendering APIs (textContent, createTextNode).

MISSING_CSRF_PROTECTION.name: Missing CSRF / Anti-Forgery Protection
MISSING_CSRF_PROTECTION.description: State-changing endpoints appear to disable or lack anti-CSRF token validation.

CORS_PREFLIGHT_BYPASS.name: CORS Preflight Bypass Risk
CORS_PREFLIGHT_BYPASS.description: Sensitive functionality may be reachable via a simple (non-preflighted) cross-origin request because Origin/Content-Type are not validated.

UNSAFE_HTTP_METHOD_FOR_SENSITIVE_ACTION.name: Sensitive Action Exposed via Safe HTTP Method
UNSAFE_HTTP_METHOD_FOR_SENSITIVE_ACTION.description: State-changing/sensitive functionality (delete, update, transfer, admin, reset) is exposed via GET/HEAD/OPTIONS rather than POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

INSECURE_WEBSOCKET.name: Insecure WebSocket (ws://) Connection
INSECURE_WEBSOCKET.description: WebSocket connections use the unencrypted ws:// scheme instead of wss://.

WEAK_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH.name: Password Minimum Length Below 8
WEAK_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH.description: Password length validation permits passwords shorter than 8 characters.

PASSWORD_CHANGE_ENDPOINT.name: Password Change Capability Marker
PASSWORD_CHANGE_ENDPOINT.description: Informational marker for a password-change endpoint; absence across the whole scan should be reviewed manually against control V6.2.2 (users can change their password).

PASSWORD_CHANGE_CURRENT_CHECK.name: Password Change Current-Password Check Marker
PASSWORD_CHANGE_CURRENT_CHECK.description: Informational marker for current/old-password verification near password-change logic (control V6.2.3).

WEAK_PASSWORD_NO_BANNED_LIST_CHECK.name: No Banned/Breached Password List Check Detected
WEAK_PASSWORD_NO_BANNED_LIST_CHECK.description: No integration with a common/breached password list (top-N list, HaveIBeenPwned, zxcvbn) detected near password validation.

OVERLY_RESTRICTIVE_PASSWORD_COMPOSITION.name: Overly Restrictive Password Composition Rule
OVERLY_RESTRICTIVE_PASSWORD_COMPOSITION.description: Password policy enforces character-composition rules (mandatory upper/lower/digit/special) which ASVS 5.0 explicitly discourages in favor of length.

PASSWORD_FIELD_NOT_MASKED.name: Password Field Not Masked
PASSWORD_FIELD_NOT_MASKED.description: A password input field does not use type="password", exposing the value in plaintext.

PASSWORD_MANAGER_BLOCKED.name: Password Manager / Paste Blocked
PASSWORD_MANAGER_BLOCKED.description: A password field disables paste, autocomplete, or browser/password-manager integration.

PASSWORD_MODIFIED_BEFORE_VERIFY.name: Password Transformed Before Verification
PASSWORD_MODIFIED_BEFORE_VERIFY.description: Password is truncated or case-transformed before comparison/hashing, weakening the effective password space.

INITIAL_PASSWORD_NOT_EXPIRING.name: Initial Password / Activation Code Expiry Marker
INITIAL_PASSWORD_NOT_EXPIRING.description: Informational marker checking for expiry/one-time-use handling of system-generated initial passwords or activation codes (control V6.4.1).

SECRET_QUESTIONS_PRESENT.name: Secret Questions / Password Hints Present
SECRET_QUESTIONS_PRESENT.description: Password hints or knowledge-based 'secret question' authentication is present, which ASVS 5.0 prohibits.

SESSION_VERIFICATION_BYPASSED.name: Session Token Verified Without Signature Check
SESSION_VERIFICATION_BYPASSED.description: A token is decoded with signature/expiration verification explicitly disabled instead of relying on the trusted backend verification path.

STATIC_SESSION_SECRET.name: Static/Hardcoded Session Secret
STATIC_SESSION_SECRET.description: Session or token signing secret appears to be a static, hardcoded value rather than dynamically generated per deployment.

SESSION_NOT_INVALIDATED_ON_LOGOUT.name: Logout Session Invalidation Marker
SESSION_NOT_INVALIDATED_ON_LOGOUT.description: Informational marker checking that logout invalidates the session/token server-side (control V7.4.1).

SESSIONS_NOT_TERMINATED_ON_ACCOUNT_DISAB.name: Account Disable Session Termination Marker
SESSIONS_NOT_TERMINATED_ON_ACCOUNT_DISAB.description: Informational marker checking whether disabling/deleting a user account also revokes that user's active sessions (control V7.4.2).

CLIENT_SIDE_AUTHORIZATION_ONLY.name: Authorization Enforced Only Client-Side
CLIENT_SIDE_AUTHORIZATION_ONLY.description: Role/permission checks appear to gate only UI visibility (client-side JS) without corresponding server-side enforcement.

JWT_HEADER_SOURCE_NOT_VALIDATED.name: JWT jku/x5u/jwk Header Trusted Without Allowlist
JWT_HEADER_SOURCE_NOT_VALIDATED.description: JWT verification resolves signing keys via a jku/x5u/jwk header without a visible allowlist check on the source.

JWT_EXP_NBF_NOT_VERIFIED.name: JWT Expiration/Not-Before Claim Not Verified
JWT_EXP_NBF_NOT_VERIFIED.description: JWT decoding explicitly disables expiration (exp) or not-before (nbf) claim verification.

CLIENT_STORAGE_NOT_CLEARED_ON_LOGOUT.name: Client Storage Clear-on-Logout Marker
CLIENT_STORAGE_NOT_CLEARED_ON_LOGOUT.description: Informational marker checking that authenticated data is cleared from localStorage/sessionStorage on logout/session termination (control V14.3.1).

COOKIE_MISSING_SAMESITE.name: Cookie Missing SameSite Attribute
COOKIE_MISSING_SAMESITE.description: Cookie set without an explicit SameSite attribute, leaving it exposed to cross-site request forgery

COOKIE_MISSING_HTTPONLY.name: Cookie Missing HttpOnly Attribute
COOKIE_MISSING_HTTPONLY.description: Session or other client-inaccessible cookie set without the HttpOnly attribute, exposing it to client-side script access

GRAPHQL_INTROSPECTION_ENABLED.name: GraphQL Introspection Enabled
GRAPHQL_INTROSPECTION_ENABLED.description: GraphQL introspection or GraphiQL explorer left enabled, exposing the full schema to unauthenticated clients

JWT_MISSING_AUDIENCE_CHECK.name: JWT Decoded Without Audience Validation
JWT_MISSING_AUDIENCE_CHECK.description: JWT verification does not validate the 'aud' claim, allowing a token issued for a different service to be accepted

WEAK_PASSWORD_HASHING.name: Weak Password Hashing Algorithm
WEAK_PASSWORD_HASHING.description: Password hashed with a fast general-purpose hash (MD5/SHA1/SHA256) instead of an approved password hashing function

FOLLOWS_REDIRECTS_ON_EXTERNAL_CALL.name: Backend HTTP Client Follows Redirects on External Call
FOLLOWS_REDIRECTS_ON_EXTERNAL_CALL.description: Backend call to an externally-controlled URL does not disable automatic redirect-following, which can be abused to reach internal resources

COOKIE_HOST_PREFIX_MISSING.name: Cookie Missing __Host- Prefix
COOKIE_HOST_PREFIX_MISSING.description: Session or authentication cookies are set without the __Host- prefix. The __Host- prefix forces Secure, no Domain, and path=/ in compliant browsers, preventing subdomain-level cookie injection attacks.

POSTMESSAGE_ORIGIN_NOT_CHECKED.name: postMessage Origin Not Validated
POSTMESSAGE_ORIGIN_NOT_CHECKED.description: A postMessage event listener processes messages without validating event.origin. An attacker from any origin can send crafted messages and trigger the handler, potentially leading to XSS or CSRF.

JSONP_ENABLED.name: JSONP Callback Response Enabled
JSONP_ENABLED.description: The application wraps JSON data in a user-controlled callback parameter, enabling JSONP/XSSI style data exfiltration.

AUTH_DATA_IN_SCRIPT_RESPONSE.name: Authorization-Required Data in Script Response
AUTH_DATA_IN_SCRIPT_RESPONSE.description: Authenticated user/session/account data appears to be emitted in a JavaScript response, creating XSSI exposure risk.

SEC_FETCH_RESOURCE_GUARD_MARKER.name: Sec-Fetch Resource Embedding Guard Marker
SEC_FETCH_RESOURCE_GUARD_MARKER.description: Compliant marker for authenticated resource endpoints that validate Sec-Fetch-Site/Mode/Dest before serving embeddable content.

EXTERNAL_ASSET_MISSING_SRI.name: Externally Hosted Asset Missing Subresource Integrity
EXTERNAL_ASSET_MISSING_SRI.description: An externally hosted script, stylesheet, or font asset is loaded without an integrity attribute.

DEPRECATED_CLIENT_TECH.name: Deprecated Client-Side Technology
DEPRECATED_CLIENT_TECH.description: The application uses a deprecated and insecure client-side technology (Flash, ActiveX, Silverlight, Java Applets, VBScript, VRML). These are end-of-life and routinely exploited via known CVEs.

SPOOFABLE_PROXY_HEADER.name: Spoofable Proxy Header Used for Access Control
SPOOFABLE_PROXY_HEADER.description: The application reads a spoofable proxy header (X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP, CF-Connecting-IP, etc.) for security decisions such as IP-based access control, rate limiting, or geo-restriction. Clients can trivially forge these headers, bypassing the control.

HTTP_REQUEST_SMUGGLING.name: HTTP Request Smuggling Risk
HTTP_REQUEST_SMUGGLING.description: The application manually constructs HTTP headers in a way that could produce conflicting Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding values, or forwards raw HTTP to an upstream without stripping hop-by-hop headers. This is a precondition for HTTP request smuggling attacks.

GRAPHQL_NO_COST_LIMIT.name: GraphQL Missing Depth/Cost Limiting
GRAPHQL_NO_COST_LIMIT.description: GraphQL endpoint is configured without depth limiting or query cost analysis. An attacker can craft deeply nested or highly expensive queries to exhaust server resources (GraphQL DoS).

WEBSOCKET_ORIGIN_NOT_CHECKED.name: WebSocket Missing Origin Validation
WEBSOCKET_ORIGIN_NOT_CHECKED.description: The server-side WebSocket connection handler does not validate the Origin header before accepting the upgrade. This allows any website to initiate a cross-origin WebSocket connection and potentially read sensitive server-push data (CSWSH).

UNSAFE_DOWNLOAD_FILENAME_ENCODING.name: Download Filename Not Encoded/Sanitized
UNSAFE_DOWNLOAD_FILENAME_ENCODING.description: Content-Disposition filename built via string interpolation/concatenation without encoding or sanitizing the filename, risking header/response-splitting or path issues

JWT_TOKEN_TYPE_NOT_VALIDATED.name: JWT Token Type Not Validated
JWT_TOKEN_TYPE_NOT_VALIDATED.description: JWT payload used for an authorization decision (scope/permissions) without first validating the token's type ('typ'/'token_type' claim), allowing an ID token to be accepted where an access token is expected

SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_BROWSER_STORAGE.name: Sensitive Data Stored in Browser Storage
SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_BROWSER_STORAGE.description: Sensitive data (password, SSN, credit card, API key/secret) stored in localStorage/sessionStorage, which ASVS only permits for session tokens

UNAUTHENTICATED_ENCRYPTION_MODE.name: Encryption Without Authentication (Non-AEAD Mode)
UNAUTHENTICATED_ENCRYPTION_MODE.description: Data encrypted with a non-authenticated cipher mode (CBC/CTR/CFB/OFB) with no separate MAC, allowing undetected ciphertext tampering; use an AEAD mode (GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305) or add an HMAC

EXPOSED_DEBUG_MONITORING_ENDPOINT.name: Exposed Debug/Documentation/Monitoring Endpoint
EXPOSED_DEBUG_MONITORING_ENDPOINT.description: API documentation, actuator, or metrics endpoint registered without an authentication guard, exposing internal implementation details or operational data

STACK_TRACE_EXPOSED_TO_CLIENT.name: Stack Trace or Exception Detail Returned to Client
STACK_TRACE_EXPOSED_TO_CLIENT.description: Raw exception message or stack trace returned directly in an HTTP response body, leaking internal implementation details to the client

INSUFFICIENT_CRYPTO_KEY_SIZE.name: Cryptographic Key Size Below 128-bit Security Level
INSUFFICIENT_CRYPTO_KEY_SIZE.description: Key generation does not meet the approved algorithm/key-size baseline: RSA/DH below 3072 bits (less than a 128-bit security level per ASVS 5.0 V11.2.3), a weak/undersized EC curve (< 256-bit, e.g. secp192r1/secp160r1), or use of DSA, which is legacy and disallowed for new key generation

XPATH_INJECTION.name: XPath Injection
XPATH_INJECTION.description: User input flows into an XPath expression via string building without escaping

SVG_SCRIPT_SANITIZATION.name: Unsanitized SVG Upload/Render
SVG_SCRIPT_SANITIZATION.description: User-supplied SVG is accepted for upload or served/rendered without stripping <script>/<foreignObject> tags via a sanitizer

SCRIPTABLE_TEMPLATE_SANITIZATION.name: Scriptable Template Renderer Allows Raw HTML
SCRIPTABLE_TEMPLATE_SANITIZATION.description: A Markdown/template renderer is configured to allow raw HTML output, or its output is injected into the DOM without a sanitizer step

FORMAT_STRING_INJECTION.name: Format String Injection
FORMAT_STRING_INJECTION.description: User input is used as the format string itself (not just an argument), allowing attribute/method injection via .format() or %-formatting

EMAIL_HEADER_INJECTION.name: SMTP/IMAP Header Injection
EMAIL_HEADER_INJECTION.description: An email header (To/Cc/Bcc/Subject) is built via concatenation with user input with no CRLF-stripping or validation

PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH_TOO_SHORT.name: Password Maximum Length Below 64 Characters
PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH_TOO_SHORT.description: A password field or validator caps password length below the ASVS-required minimum of 64 characters, rejecting valid passphrases and password-manager-generated passwords

WEAK_OTP_ENTROPY.name: OTP/Lookup Secret Below Minimum Entropy
WEAK_OTP_ENTROPY.description: An OTP, verification code, or lookup secret is generated from a numeric range or charset providing fewer than roughly 20 bits of entropy, regardless of whether the underlying RNG is a CSPRNG

OTP_ENDPOINT_RATE_LIMITING.name: Rate Limiting Marker Near OTP Verification Endpoint
OTP_ENDPOINT_RATE_LIMITING.description: Informational marker for a rate-limiting decorator/middleware found near an OTP or verification-code endpoint (control V6.6.3).

OUTPUT_ENCODING_NOT_FINAL_STEP.name: Output Encoding Not Applied as Final Step
OUTPUT_ENCODING_NOT_FINAL_STEP.description: Untrusted data is escaped or encoded and then concatenated with additional untrusted input before reaching an interpreter, so output encoding is not the final operation.

LATEX_INJECTION.name: LaTeX Injection
LATEX_INJECTION.description: User-controlled content is inserted into LaTeX source without escaping control characters, or LaTeX compilation is run with shell escape enabled.

JNDI_INJECTION.name: JNDI Injection
JNDI_INJECTION.description: A JNDI lookup name is built from request data through concatenation before being passed to InitialContext.lookup().

MEMCACHE_INJECTION.name: Memcache Injection
MEMCACHE_INJECTION.description: A memcache key or value is built through concatenation with untrusted input and passed to get/set without key sanitization.

BUSINESS_ENDPOINT_ANTI_AUTOMATION_MARKER.name: Anti-Automation Marker Near Business-Critical Endpoint
BUSINESS_ENDPOINT_ANTI_AUTOMATION_MARKER.description: Compliant marker for a rate-limit or CAPTCHA control near checkout, bulk export, invite-sending, or similar business-critical endpoints.

FORCED_PERIODIC_PASSWORD_ROTATION.name: Forced Periodic Password Rotation
FORCED_PERIODIC_PASSWORD_ROTATION.description: Password age or expiry is used to block login and force password reset without a compromise or risk signal.

CONTEXT_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD_BLOCKLIST_MARK.name: Context-Specific Password Blocklist Marker
CONTEXT_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD_BLOCKLIST_MARK.description: Compliant marker for password validation that checks application-specific blocked terms such as company, product, tenant, app, or brand names.

OTP_SINGLE_USE_NOT_ENFORCED.name: OTP or Lookup Secret Can Be Reused
OTP_SINGLE_USE_NOT_ENFORCED.description: An OTP or lookup-secret verification path checks the code but does not delete, invalidate, consume, or mark it used after success.

PLAINTEXT_LOOKUP_SECRET_STORAGE.name: Lookup Secret Stored in Plaintext
PLAINTEXT_LOOKUP_SECRET_STORAGE.description: Low-entropy lookup secrets such as recovery codes or API keys are stored in plaintext model/schema fields instead of salted hashes.

OTP_OOB_LIFETIME_TOO_LONG.name: OTP or OOB Code Lifetime Too Long
OTP_OOB_LIFETIME_TOO_LONG.description: OTP or out-of-band verification codes are generated without an expiry, or with a lifetime above ASVS limits.

SESSION_ABSOLUTE_LIFETIME_MARKER.name: Absolute Session Lifetime Marker
SESSION_ABSOLUTE_LIFETIME_MARKER.description: Compliant marker for a hard session or token lifetime independent of inactivity timeout.

OAUTH_AUTHZ_MISSING_STATE_PKCE.name: OAuth Authorization Request Missing State or PKCE
OAUTH_AUTHZ_MISSING_STATE_PKCE.description: OAuth authorization request construction lacks CSRF replay protection through state and PKCE code_challenge.

OAUTH_TOKEN_REQUEST_NO_CLIENT_AUTH.name: OAuth Token Request Missing Client Authentication
OAUTH_TOKEN_REQUEST_NO_CLIENT_AUTH.description: OAuth confidential client token request is sent to the token endpoint without client_secret, client_assertion, Authorization header, or auth parameter.

ID_TOKEN_NONCE_NOT_CHECKED.name: ID Token Nonce Not Checked
ID_TOKEN_NONCE_NOT_CHECKED.description: ID token validation decodes or verifies an ID token without comparing the nonce claim to the authorization-session nonce.

WEAK_SIGNATURE_HASH_COLLISION.name: Weak Collision-Resistance Hash for Signature or Integrity
WEAK_SIGNATURE_HASH_COLLISION.description: SHA-1 or MD5 is used where collision resistance is required, such as digital signatures or integrity checks.

WEAK_KDF_PARAMETERS.name: Weak KDF Stretching Parameters
WEAK_KDF_PARAMETERS.description: PBKDF2 or scrypt is configured with stretching parameters below current guidance.

PLAINTEXT_BACKEND_CONNECTION.name: Plaintext Backend Connection
PLAINTEXT_BACKEND_CONNECTION.description: Backend, database, API, or outbound HTTP client connections use http:// instead of TLS-protected https:// endpoints.

SESSION_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MARKER.name: Session Inactivity Timeout Marker
SESSION_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a session inactivity timeout being configured (PERMANENT_SESSION_LIFETIME, session.permanent, a session cookie maxAge, or a short-lived JWT exp claim).

SENSITIVE_CHANGE_NO_REAUTH.name: Sensitive Account Change Without Re-authentication
SENSITIVE_CHANGE_NO_REAUTH.description: A route that changes email, phone, or MFA settings has no password/re-authentication check visible in the handler

EXCESSIVE_DATA_EXPOSURE_BOPLA.name: Excessive Data Exposure via Full Object Serialization
EXCESSIVE_DATA_EXPOSURE_BOPLA.description: An API response serializes an entire model object (jsonify(obj.__dict__), vars(obj), or a bare res.json(obj)) with no explicit field allowlist

HANDROLLED_CRYPTO_PRIMITIVE.name: Hand-Rolled Cryptographic Primitive
HANDROLLED_CRYPTO_PRIMITIVE.description: A custom cryptographic primitive (e.g. a manual XOR cipher) is used instead of an industry-validated library such as cryptography, pycryptodome, or the Node crypto module

OUTBOUND_REQUEST_ALLOWLIST_CHECK.name: Outbound Request Allowlist Marker
OUTBOUND_REQUEST_ALLOWLIST_CHECK.description: Informational marker for an ALLOWED_HOSTS/allowlist check found near an outbound HTTP call site (control V13.2.4).

JS_LOOSE_EQUALITY_SECURITY_CHECK.name: Loose Equality Used for Security-Relevant Comparison
JS_LOOSE_EQUALITY_SECURITY_CHECK.description: JavaScript loose equality (== / !=) is used to compare an auth token, role, or ID instead of strict equality (=== / !==)

OAUTH_CALLBACK_STATE_NOT_VALIDATED.name: OAuth Callback Missing Session-Bound State Validation
OAUTH_CALLBACK_STATE_NOT_VALIDATED.description: An OAuth callback handler reads state/code from the query string and exchanges the authorization code for a token without comparing state against a value stored earlier in that user's own session, allowing CSRF/login-CSRF via a crafted callback URL.

OIDC_ISSUER_NOT_VALIDATED.name: OIDC Token Handling Missing Issuer Validation
OIDC_ISSUER_NOT_VALIDATED.description: An OAuth/OIDC token or callback handler decodes/verifies a token without validating the iss (issuer) claim against the expected authorization server, leaving the client open to mix-up attacks across multiple trusted issuers.

OIDC_USER_LOOKUP_MISSING_ISSUER.name: User Lookup Keyed on sub Without Issuer
OIDC_USER_LOOKUP_MISSING_ISSUER.description: A user record is looked up or created using only the token's sub claim, without also matching iss (issuer). Since sub is only unique per-issuer, a malicious or federated identity provider can mint a colliding sub and impersonate an existing account.

STEPUP_CLAIMS_NOT_VALIDATED.name: Sensitive Action Missing Step-Up Auth Claim Check
STEPUP_CLAIMS_NOT_VALIDATED.description: A route performing a sensitive, high-risk action (funds transfer, withdrawal, account deletion) never inspects the acr, amr, or auth_time claims from the token to confirm the required authentication strength/recency for step-up authorization.

OAUTH_AUTHZ_MISSING_PKCE.name: OAuth Authorization URL Missing PKCE Parameters
OAUTH_AUTHZ_MISSING_PKCE.description: An authorization-URL builder targeting the /authorize endpoint omits code_challenge/code_challenge_method, so the authorization code grant is not protected by PKCE.

REFRESH_TOKEN_NO_EXPIRY.name: Refresh Token Issued Without Absolute Expiration
REFRESH_TOKEN_NO_EXPIRY.description: Refresh-token issuance (creation call or datastore insert) sets no expiry field, so the refresh token has no absolute lifetime and remains valid indefinitely.

OIDC_CLIENT_KEYS_BY_EMAIL_NOT_SUB.name: Client Keys Local Account on Email/Name Instead of sub
OIDC_CLIENT_KEYS_BY_EMAIL_NOT_SUB.description: OIDC client code links or creates the local account using email or name from the ID token payload instead of the stable sub identifier, which can change or be reused/reassigned by the identity provider.

OIDC_DISCOVERY_HTTP_OR_UNVALIDATED.name: OIDC Discovery Document Fetched Insecurely
OIDC_DISCOVERY_HTTP_OR_UNVALIDATED.description: The OIDC discovery document (.well-known/openid-configuration) is fetched over plain HTTP, or its issuer is never validated against the expected value, allowing a spoofed authorization-server metadata document to redirect the client to attacker-controlled endpoints.

ID_TOKEN_AUDIENCE_NOT_CHECKED.name: ID Token Verified Without Audience Check
ID_TOKEN_AUDIENCE_NOT_CHECKED.description: ID token verification decodes/verifies the token without checking that the aud claim equals this client's client_id, allowing an ID token issued for a different client at the same provider to be accepted.

LOGOUT_TOKEN_NOT_VALIDATED.name: Back-Channel Logout Token Not Validated
LOGOUT_TOKEN_NOT_VALIDATED.description: A back-channel-logout endpoint decodes a logout_token without checking the events, sid, sub, or typ claims required by OIDC Back-Channel Logout, allowing a forged or replayed logout token to terminate an arbitrary session.

OIDC_OP_ALLOWS_FRAGMENT_RESPONSE.name: Authorization Server Allows Implicit/Fragment Response Type
OIDC_OP_ALLOWS_FRAGMENT_RESPONSE.description: The authorization-server implementation allows response_type=token or id_token (or response_mode=fragment), returning tokens via the URL fragment instead of requiring the code or form_post response mode.

WEAK_TLS_CIPHER_SUITE.name: Weak TLS Cipher Suite Configured
WEAK_TLS_CIPHER_SUITE.description: Application-level TLS server/context configuration (Python ssl.SSLContext.set_ciphers, Node tls.createServer) explicitly enables a weak cipher suite (RC4/3DES/DES/MD5/NULL/EXPORT/anonymous Diffie-Hellman).

INTERNAL_SERVICE_PLAINTEXT_HTTP.name: Internal Service-to-Service Call Over Plaintext HTTP
INTERNAL_SERVICE_PLAINTEXT_HTTP.description: An outbound service-to-service call targets an internal-looking host (private IP range, .internal/.local/.svc suffix, or a bare service-mesh hostname) over plain http:// instead of TLS-protected https://.

SERVICE_AUTH_SHORT_LIVED_CREDENTIALS_MAR.name: Service Authentication Uses Short-Lived Credentials
SERVICE_AUTH_SHORT_LIVED_CREDENTIALS_MAR.description: Informational marker for service-to-service authentication using short-term, dynamically issued credentials (OAuth client-credentials grant, cloud STS AssumeRole, or Vault dynamic secrets) rather than a static long-lived password or API key.

CACHED_SENSITIVE_DATA_SERVER_SIDE.name: Sensitive Data Cached Server-Side Without Short TTL
CACHED_SENSITIVE_DATA_SERVER_SIDE.description: A server-side cache-set call stores a sensitive-looking key or value (password, token, SSN, card number) with no TTL/expiration parameter, leaving the sensitive data resident in the cache indefinitely.

SENSITIVE_DATA_TO_THIRD_PARTY_TRACKER.name: Sensitive Data Sent to Third-Party Tracker
SENSITIVE_DATA_TO_THIRD_PARTY_TRACKER.description: An analytics, tracking, or error-reporting call (analytics.track, gtag, mixpanel.track, Sentry) includes a sensitive field (password, token, SSN, card number) directly in the event payload sent to a third-party service.

SBOM_MAINTAINED_MARKER.name: SBOM Generation Marker
SBOM_MAINTAINED_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation step or file (CycloneDX, Syft, sbom.json) found in the repository or CI configuration.

TEST_DEBUG_CODE_IN_PRODUCTION.name: Leftover Test/Debug Code Without Environment Gate
TEST_DEBUG_CODE_IN_PRODUCTION.description: Leftover debug/test route, hardcoded test-user credential check, or a 'remove before prod' marker was found with no surrounding environment check (DEBUG/ENV/environment) gating it out of production.

HTTP_PARAMETER_POLLUTION_MISSING_DEFENSE.name: HTTP Parameter Pollution Missing Defense
HTTP_PARAMETER_POLLUTION_MISSING_DEFENSE.description: A route handler reads a query parameter (req.query.x, request.args.get) and uses it in a security-sensitive way (query building, comparison, redirect) without validating for duplicate parameters (Array.isArray/getlist) or hpp-style middleware protection.

UTC_TIMESTAMP_LOGGING_MARKER.name: UTC/ISO8601 Timestamp Logging Marker
UTC_TIMESTAMP_LOGGING_MARKER.description: Informational marker for log timestamps generated with a synchronized, unambiguous clock source (datetime.utcnow(), datetime.now(timezone.utc), Date.toISOString()) rather than unqualified local time.

SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_LOG_STATEMENT.name: Sensitive Data Embedded Directly in Log Statement
SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_LOG_STATEMENT.description: A log call embeds a sensitive field (password, token, SSN, card number) directly in the message via string interpolation or concatenation, with no redaction/masking call wrapping the value.

AUTH_OPERATION_LOGGED_MARKER.name: Authentication Operation Logging Marker
AUTH_OPERATION_LOGGED_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a log call found inside a login, logout, password-change, or MFA handler (control V16.3.1).

AUTHZ_DENIAL_LOGGED_MARKER.name: Authorization Denial Logging Marker
AUTHZ_DENIAL_LOGGED_MARKER.description: Informational marker for an authorization-denial branch (403/Forbidden) followed by a log call (control V16.3.2).

SIGNALING_FLOOD_RATE_LIMITING.name: Rate Limiting Marker Near WebRTC Signaling Handler
SIGNALING_FLOOD_RATE_LIMITING.description: Informational marker for a rate-limiting decorator/middleware found near a WebRTC signaling handler (socket.on('offer'/'answer'/'ice-candidate') or a /signal, /offer, /answer HTTP route), guarding against signaling-channel flood (control V17.3.1).

AUTH_CHECK_FAILS_OPEN.name: Authorization Check Fails Open on Exception
AUTH_CHECK_FAILS_OPEN.description: An exception handler around an auth/authorization check defaults to allow instead of deny (except: return True, catch(e){ next() }), so an unexpected error grants access rather than denying it.

STRUCTURED_LOGGING_MARKER.name: Structured/Correlatable Logging Marker
STRUCTURED_LOGGING_MARKER.description: Informational marker for structured, machine-parseable logging setup (python-json-logger, structlog, winston JSON format, pino) which makes log entries correlatable in a common format across services (control V16.2.4).

ADMIN_SESSION_TERMINATION_MARKER.name: Admin Session Termination Endpoint Marker
ADMIN_SESSION_TERMINATION_MARKER.description: Informational marker for an administrative endpoint or function that terminates another user's active session (control V7.4.5).

SELF_SERVICE_SESSION_MANAGEMENT_MARKER.name: Self-Service Session Management Endpoint Marker
SELF_SERVICE_SESSION_MANAGEMENT_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a self-service endpoint letting a user view or terminate their own active sessions (control V7.5.2).

TOKEN_REVOCATION_ENDPOINT_MARKER.name: Token Revocation Endpoint Marker
TOKEN_REVOCATION_ENDPOINT_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a token revocation endpoint or function (RFC 7009-style /oauth/revoke, revoke_token) allowing refresh/reference tokens to be revoked (control V10.4.9).

CONSENT_MANAGEMENT_ENDPOINT_MARKER.name: Consent Management Endpoint Marker
CONSENT_MANAGEMENT_ENDPOINT_MARKER.description: Informational marker for an endpoint letting a user review or revoke previously granted OAuth/OIDC consents (control V10.7.3).

LOG_TRANSPORT_PLAINTEXT.name: Logs Shipped Over Plaintext Transport
LOG_TRANSPORT_PLAINTEXT.description: Logs are shipped to a remote collector over plain HTTP or an explicitly non-TLS transport, instead of an encrypted connection (control V16.4.3).

CENTRALIZED_LOG_SHIPPING_MARKER.name: Centralized Log Shipping Marker
CENTRALIZED_LOG_SHIPPING_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a known centralized-logging integration (Datadog, Splunk, ELK/Logstash, CloudWatch Logs, Fluentd, Loki) being configured, evidence logs are sent to an approved destination rather than left local-only (control V16.2.3).

TENANT_ISOLATION_MISSING.name: Tenant-Scoped Route Missing Tenant Filter
TENANT_ISOLATION_MISSING.description: A route explicitly scoped to a tenant (/tenants/<id>/...) queries data without filtering by tenant_id/org_id, allowing cross-tenant data access in a multi-tenant application (control V8.4.1).

CSV_FORMULA_INJECTION.name: CSV/Spreadsheet Formula Injection
CSV_FORMULA_INJECTION.description: User-controlled data flows into a CSV or spreadsheet (XLS/XLSX/ODF) export without escaping a leading formula-trigger character (=, +, -, @, tab, or null), allowing formula injection when the exported file is opened in a spreadsheet application.

REDOS_VULNERABLE_REGEX.name: Regular Expression Vulnerable to Catastrophic Backtracking (ReDoS)
REDOS_VULNERABLE_REGEX.description: A regular expression literal contains a nested quantifier (e.g. (a+)+, (\w*)*) â€” a classic exponential-backtracking shape that can cause a Regular expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) when matched against attacker-controlled input.

HUMAN_TIMING_ENFORCEMENT_MARKER.name: Human-Timing / Anti-Automation Marker
HUMAN_TIMING_ENFORCEMENT_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a mechanism enforcing realistic human timing on a business logic flow â€” a minimum-elapsed-time check between form load and submission, or a CAPTCHA/challenge â€” preventing excessively rapid, bot-speed transaction submissions (control V2.4.2).

MANUAL_TRANSFER_ENCODING_HEADER.name: Manually Set Transfer-Encoding Header
MANUAL_TRANSFER_ENCODING_HEADER.description: Application code manually sets the connection-specific Transfer-Encoding header, which can conflict with the framing the underlying HTTP library/proxy applies and enable request smuggling or response-splitting attacks.

REQUEST_LENGTH_VALIDATION_MARKER.name: Outbound Request Length Validation Marker
REQUEST_LENGTH_VALIDATION_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a length check on a built URI or HTTP header (Authorization, Cookie) before it's sent, preventing an overly long outbound request from causing a denial of service against the receiving component (control V4.2.5).

UPLOAD_QUOTA_PER_USER_MARKER.name: Upload Quota Per User Marker
UPLOAD_QUOTA_PER_USER_MARKER.description: Compliant marker for per-user upload quota or per-user file count limits near upload handling.

ARCHIVE_SYMLINK_EXTRACTION.name: Archive Extraction Without Symlink Check
ARCHIVE_SYMLINK_EXTRACTION.description: Compressed archive extraction without rejecting symlink entries or enforcing a symlink target allowlist.

UPLOAD_IMAGE_DIMENSION_LIMIT_MARKER.name: Uploaded Image Dimension Limit Marker
UPLOAD_IMAGE_DIMENSION_LIMIT_MARKER.description: Compliant marker for rejecting uploaded images that exceed maximum width, height, pixel count, or decoder pixel limits.

SUSPICIOUS_AUTH_NOTIFICATION_MARKER.name: Suspicious Authentication Attempt Notification Marker
SUSPICIOUS_AUTH_NOTIFICATION_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a notification/email call found near failed-login or login-anomaly-detection logic (control V6.3.5).

EMAIL_USED_AS_AUTH_FACTOR.name: Email Address Used as Authentication Factor
EMAIL_USED_AS_AUTH_FACTOR.description: The submitted password/credential value is compared directly against the user's email address, using email as a single-factor or MFA authentication mechanism.

AUTH_DETAIL_CHANGE_NOTIFICATION_MARKER.name: Authentication Detail Change Notification Marker
AUTH_DETAIL_CHANGE_NOTIFICATION_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a notification call found inside a password-reset, credential-reset, or email/username-change handler (control V6.3.7).

USER_ENUMERATION_VIA_AUTH_ERRORS.name: User Enumeration via Distinct Authentication Error Messages
USER_ENUMERATION_VIA_AUTH_ERRORS.description: A single auth/registration/forgot-password handler returns a distinct error string for 'user not found' versus 'wrong password', allowing valid accounts to be deduced from error responses.

ADMIN_RESET_SETS_PASSWORD_DIRECTLY.name: Admin Password Reset Sets Password Directly
ADMIN_RESET_SETS_PASSWORD_DIRECTLY.description: An admin-facing password-reset endpoint accepts a direct new_password parameter instead of only triggering a reset-email/token flow, letting an administrator choose or see a user's resulting password.

AUTH_FACTOR_REVOCATION_ENDPOINT_MARKER.name: Authentication Factor Revocation Endpoint Marker
AUTH_FACTOR_REVOCATION_ENDPOINT_MARKER.description: Informational marker for an endpoint or function that revokes an authentication factor (device, authenticator, security key) on theft/loss (control V6.5.6).

BIOMETRIC_AS_SOLE_FACTOR.name: Biometric Authentication Used as Sole Factor
BIOMETRIC_AS_SOLE_FACTOR.description: A biometric verification call is immediately followed by a login-success/session-grant with no other authentication factor (password/OTP/PIN) checked nearby.

TOTP_CLIENT_TIME_TRUSTED.name: TOTP Verified Against Client-Supplied Timestamp
TOTP_CLIENT_TIME_TRUSTED.description: TOTP verification uses a client-supplied timestamp parameter (for_time or equivalent) instead of a trusted server-side time source.

PUSH_MFA_RATE_LIMITING_MARKER.name: Rate Limiting Marker Near Push-MFA Endpoint
PUSH_MFA_RATE_LIMITING_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a rate-limiting decorator/middleware found near a push-notification MFA endpoint (control V6.6.4).

WEAK_CHALLENGE_NONCE.name: Weak or Undersized Challenge Nonce
WEAK_CHALLENGE_NONCE.description: A cryptographic challenge nonce is generated with fewer than 64 bits of entropy or via a non-CSPRNG/time-based source (small token_bytes/urandom, random.randint, uuid1).

ADAPTIVE_AUTH_MARKER.name: Adaptive/Risk-Based Authentication Marker
ADAPTIVE_AUTH_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a risk-scoring/adaptive-auth library call or geoip-conditional logic found near login or session-check logic (control V8.2.4).

OAUTH_WILDCARD_SCOPE_REQUEST.name: OAuth Client Requests Wildcard/Overbroad Scope
OAUTH_WILDCARD_SCOPE_REQUEST.description: An OAuth authorization request asks for a wildcard or catch-all scope (scope=* or scope=all) instead of the specific, minimal set of scopes the client actually needs.

BEARER_TOKEN_NOT_SENDER_CONSTRAINED.name: Bearer Access Token Accepted Without Sender Constraint
BEARER_TOKEN_NOT_SENDER_CONSTRAINED.description: A resource server extracts and verifies a bearer access token without checking a DPoP proof or mTLS-bound (cnf claim) constraint, leaving it vulnerable to replay if the token is stolen.

MAC_THEN_ENCRYPT_PATTERN.name: MAC-then-Encrypt Instead of Encrypt-then-MAC
MAC_THEN_ENCRYPT_PATTERN.description: A MAC/HMAC is computed over the plaintext before a separate non-AEAD (CBC/CTR/CFB/OFB) encryption step, instead of computing the MAC over the ciphertext (encrypt-then-MAC), which can enable padding-oracle-style attacks.

CRYPTO_VIA_ISOLATED_SECURITY_MODULE_MARK.name: Cryptographic Operation Delegated to an Isolated Security Module
CRYPTO_VIA_ISOLATED_SECURITY_MODULE_MARK.description: Informational marker for a cryptographic operation performed via an isolated security module (cloud KMS, HashiCorp Vault transit engine, or a PKCS#11-backed HSM) rather than in application-space key material (control V13.3.3).

UNMASKED_SENSITIVE_FIELD_IN_RESPONSE.name: Unmasked Sensitive Field Returned in API Response
UNMASKED_SENSITIVE_FIELD_IN_RESPONSE.description: A full, unmasked value of a highly sensitive field (card number, SSN, bank account) is serialized directly into an API response instead of a masked/truncated representation, extending the SENSITIVE_DATA_EXPOSURE/EXCESSIVE_DATA_EXPOSURE_BOPLA family to this specific over-disclosure shape (control V14.2.6).

DATA_RETENTION_DELETION_JOB_MARKER.name: Data Retention Deletion Job Marker
DATA_RETENTION_DELETION_JOB_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a retention/TTL-based deletion job (scheduled purge, MongoDB TTL index, or a DELETE ... WHERE created_at < cutoff pattern) found in the codebase, weak evidence that stale sensitive data is removed on a schedule (control V14.2.7).

UPLOAD_METADATA_NOT_STRIPPED.name: Uploaded File Metadata Not Stripped
UPLOAD_METADATA_NOT_STRIPPED.description: File-upload handling saves the uploaded file with no accompanying metadata-stripping call (EXIF/GPS/author data), risking exposure of sensitive metadata embedded in user-submitted files (control V14.2.8).

LAST_RESORT_ERROR_HANDLER_MARKER.name: Last-Resort Unhandled Exception Handler Marker
LAST_RESORT_ERROR_HANDLER_MARKER.description: Informational marker for a top-level 'last resort' handler that catches all otherwise-unhandled exceptions (a global sys.excepthook/FastAPI exception_handler(Exception) in Python, or process.on('uncaughtException'/'unhandledRejection', ...)/a final 4-arg Express error middleware in Node), avoiding an unrecorded crash of the whole process (control V16.5.4).

SDP_FINGERPRINT_VERIFICATION_MARKER.name: DTLS Certificate vs SDP Fingerprint Verification Marker
SDP_FINGERPRINT_VERIFICATION_MARKER.description: Informational marker for SDP offer/answer handling that compares the DTLS certificate presented at handshake time against the fingerprint attribute exchanged in the SDP, evidence the stream would be rejected on a mismatch (control V17.2.8).
